text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
*Haa*, *haa*... Ngh! D-Don't worry about 
me... It's just because of... the weights 
in my shoe soles...

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
Every time I move, I end up like this... 
...I must look quite unsightly right now, 
but...!

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
I will get used to it soon... and handle 
it with a cool head and light steps, just 
you watch...!

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
"...Yes, that's right. Even to you, who 
manages all of this on top of dance 
lessons...!"

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
"...I won't lose...! I won't lose to you, 
Gentildonna...!!"
